result_preview.title: Hazardous Substance Regulatory Validation API
result_preview.shortDescription: Validates hazardous substances against regulatory requirements and compliance standards.
result_preview.description: Exposes hazardous substance data for real-time regulatory validation against global compliance frameworks. Retrieves substance classifications, regulatory thresholds, and restriction status to ensure materials meet current safety and environmental standards. Manages substance compliance attestation and provides access to regulatory change notifications.

result_preview.title: Regulated Material Declaration and Certification API
result_preview.shortDescription: Provides access to regulated material declarations, certifications, and safety attribute data throughout product development and manufacturing.
result_preview.description: Exposes regulated material declarations, safety certifications, and compliance validation records integrated with bill of materials and engineering change workflows. Enables retrieval of substance certifications, regulatory requirement cross-references, and safety attribute documentation. Supports material usage tracking, compliance status verification, and hazmat documentation linking across product lifecycle processes.

result_preview.title: Incident Root Cause Analysis Agent
result_preview.shortDescription: Autonomously analyzes safety incidents to identify root causes and recommend corrective actions.
result_preview.description: This AI agent automatically processes reported SafetyIncidents by analyzing incident data, environmental factors, and historical patterns to determine underlying root causes. It generates structured root cause analysis reports with recommended corrective and preventive actions, prioritized by risk severity and regulatory impact. The agent accelerates investigation workflows and ensures consistent, evidence-based analysis across the enterprise.
